public_rationale: The two-year revenue condition is not due until September 29, 2028. No decisive early event establishes that condition. Current financing strain cannot substitute for a missed future revenue target or prove the three consequences. The conditional-forecast rule therefore prevents scoring the outcome while the antecedent remains unknown.
limitations: The horizon records the antecedent deadline; the consequences have no separate deadline.
An eventual shortfall by only one company may leave the condition ambiguous.
The claim does not identify OpenAI's target or the specific investments and debts affected.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If Anthropic and OpenAI fail to reach the revenue their valuations rest on (for Anthropic, $190–200 billion a year within two years), everybody suffers: hyperscalers miss revenue estimates, AI data center debt goes unpaid, and venture capitalists find their holdings washed out.
conditions: if Anthropic and OpenAI fail to reach the revenue their valuations are based on

statement.excerpt: If they fail to do so, everybody suffers. Hyperscalers miss revenue estimates. AI data center debt goes unpaid. Venture capitalists find their holdings washed out.

from_speaker: If they fail to do so
AI data center debt goes unpaid
Venture capitalists find their holdings washed out
our_interpretation: 'Fail to do so' refers to the preceding revenue expectations, including Anthropic's $190–200 billion of annual revenue within two years.
The plain reading predicts material harm across the three named groups, rather than literally every company and investor suffering.
Hyperscaler misses must be measured against estimates fixed before results; unpaid debt means missed contractual payments; washed-out holdings means severe realized losses or write-downs.
The two-year deadline applies to the revenue condition. The speaker gives no separate deadline for the consequences.
The horizon ends September 29, 2028 for the antecedent; failure during an interim quarter does not establish failure by that deadline.
criteria.support_condition: After the specified revenue failure is established, evidence shows all three material consequences: hyperscaler revenue misses, AI data center debt nonpayment and severe venture investment losses, linked to the labs' shortfall.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent is established and sufficient follow-up is available, comparable evidence shows the asserted consequences do not occur. If only some consequences occur, evaluate the components separately rather than treating the entire forecast as supported.
